subject: Supplier onboarding: India GST invoice schema, HSN mapping, and GSTIN validation process
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aarti Patel <aarti.patel@navgurukul.in>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 03:12:00 +0530
Subject: Supplier onboarding: India GST invoice schema, HSN mapping, and GSTIN validation process

Hi Aarti,

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. We're ready to create a first PO but need a couple of items from your side to make sure our finance system records the tax lines correctly and the supplier portal validates invoices automatically. Can you send: 

- A sample invoice in XML (e-invoice or a simple structured XML) that shows line-level HSN/SAC codes, taxable value, integrated/central/state tax breakup (IGST/CGST/SGST) and total GST amount. If you already support IRN/e-invoice schema (JSON/XML), please include an example.
- A copy of your GST registration certificate (GSTIN) and a short note on whether you issue B2B invoices under forward charge or if any items are eligible for reverse charge.
- Confirmation of the exact GSTIN format you use (usually 15 chars) and whether your system provides programmatic GSTIN validation or a lookup endpoint we can call when validating invoices.
- Bank remit instructions and whether the invoiced amount should be net of GST or includes GST in the total (so we can map PO_total vs tax_amount).

If possible, attach the files to this thread. Our PO system expects a field mapping file: PO_line_item_code -> HSN/SAC -> tax_rate. If you can provide sample mappings for your top 5 SKUs/services that'd speed up onboarding.

Target timeline: once we receive the XML sample and GST cert, finance will attempt a dry run and should be able to issue a PO within 3 business days.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachment: PO-template-for-vendor-onboarding.xlsx (referenced)

From: Aarti Patel <aarti.patel@navgurukul.in>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 04:45:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: India GST invoice schema, HSN mapping, and GSTIN validation process

Hi Hannah / Neha,

Thanks for the clear list — attaching the samples. Please see the two attachments:

1) sample-invoice-india-gst.xml (application/xml) — sample invoice in a compact XML we export from our ERP. Top-level elements: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, SellerGSTIN, BuyerGSTIN, LineItems (each line includes HSNCode, Description, Quantity, UnitPrice, TaxableValue, CGST, SGST, IGST, TotalLineAmount).

Snippet from the XML (line item example):
<LineItem>
  <HSNCode>998312</HSNCode>
  <Description>ML consulting - hourly</Description>
  <Quantity>10</Quantity>
  <UnitPrice>15000.00</UnitPrice>
  <TaxableValue>150000.00</TaxableValue>
  <IGST>27000.00</IGST>
  <TotalLineAmount>177000.00</TotalLineAmount>
</LineItem>

2) gst-registration-certificate.pdf (application/pdf) — official GSTIN: 27AABCN1234P1Z9 (example). We also included a short readme in the PDF footer indicating we do not use reverse charge for our SaaS/consulting invoices — standard forward charge applies.

Regarding GSTIN validation: we do not currently expose a public API, but our finance team validates GSTINs against the GSTN portal during onboarding and issues an e-invoice IRN for invoices above the e-invoicing threshold. If Redwood needs an automatic lookup, we can share a CSV of active GSTINs during onboarding and update it quarterly.

For HSN mapping: we've included a mapping.csv listing our top 12 services and their HSN codes. If Redwood needs a different code mapping for PO_line_item_code, tell us the PO codes and we will return mapped HSNs in the requested CSV format.

Lead time: once we have the PO and bank remittance details, we can turn around a pro forma invoice within 2 business days.

Best,
Aarti Patel
Finance & Operations | Navgurukul Labs
aarti.patel@navgurukul.in

Attachments: sample-invoice-india-gst.xml, gst-registration-certificate.pdf, hsn-mapping.csv

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aarti Patel <aarti.patel@navgurukul.in>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 06:02:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: India GST invoice schema, HSN mapping, and GSTIN validation process

Hi Aarti,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments — very helpful. A couple of clarifying questions before we run the dry invoice test: 

- The XML snippet shows IGST at the line level. Can you confirm whether you ever issue CGST+SGST split (we need both formats supported depending on inter-state vs intra-state billing)?
- For the GSTIN you listed, can you confirm the legal entity name that matches our vendor master so we have an exact match for payment approvals? 
- For e-invoice IRN: do you generate the IRN pre-invoice (we receive it with the invoice) or after payment? We prefer receiving IRN/QR on the invoice PDF so our accounts-payable can auto-validate the document.
- Bank remit: please confirm whether bank details are included per invoice or centralized in vendor profile. Our AP prefers bank details on each invoice for reconciliation.

If you can reply to these items we'll proceed with a dry run in our sandbox and generate a PO. If everything looks good in the dry run, PO issuance and live portal onboarding should follow within 48–72 hours.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sourcing Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aarti Patel <aarti.patel@navgurukul.in>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 07:48:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: India GST invoice schema, HSN mapping, and GSTIN validation process

Aarti — thank you. Quick confirmation and next steps: 

- Neha: once Aarti confirms the CGST/SGST split possibility and IRN timing we will schedule the sandbox dry-run.
- Vivek: finance will use the GSTIN and legal name to seed vendor master. Vivek, please flag if we need any extra tax forms for India (we have UEN/other in APAC checklist).
- Aarti: please upload the three attachments to the HubSpot onboarding link (provided above) so our onboarding tracker picks them up automatically. Also please attach a scanned cancelled cheque for bank details if your portal does not include bank per invoice.

We aim to have PO-4821 issued by Wed 2026-06-03 EOD provided the dry run passes. Please confirm if that timeline works.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
